name: Administration
overview: Scripture reveals that godly administration involves orderly leadership and faithful service within the body of Christ. The Lord commands His people to diligently obey His commandments, promising exaltation when they do so (Deuteronomy 28:1). Early church challenges, such as the neglect of widows, were addressed through appointed ministry roles to ensure equitable care (Acts 6:1). Furthermore, Christ equips the church with various leaders—apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers—to build up the body (Ephesians 4:11), while elders are to be ordained and set in order to maintain proper governance and spiritual oversight (Titus 1:5).
